pages.title: Loading the Circle
pages.text: The catalyst belongs in the Core; each listed surrounding ingredient gets its own injector. Their order around the circle does not matter—a welcome mercy.$(br2)Every participating injector must meet the recipe's minimum tier. A higher-tier injector also works.

pages.title: The Moment It Wakes
pages.text: Connect every injector to energy. Once the Core recognizes the arrangement, open it and start crafting. The injectors charge first; the final animation waits until every one has received its share.$(br2)The Core screen and the injectors themselves show whether the process is advancing.

pages.title: Notes from Failed Attempts
pages.text: Check in order: catalyst and ingredient counts; empty extra injectors; minimum injector tier; inward facing; clear sight lines; and energy at every injector.$(br2)Two blocks away still looks plausible, but it is too close in this version. Three blocks is the true minimum.

pages.title: Advanced Injectors
pages.text: Wyvern and Awakened injectors are themselves made by Fusion. Each higher tier accepts recipes at its own tier and below; replacing the whole circle at once avoids one forgotten weak injector.

pages.title: Chaotic Injector
pages.text: The Chaotic injector is the final step in this chain and another Fusion product. Its item portrait replaces the unsupported Fusion recipe frame that would otherwise be blank.
